intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for ValidatedSampleStream. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation. Outbound port of the bounded, backpressure-aware validated sample event stream (customer-supplier link to History). methods.semantics: Completes when the event is accepted by the bounded buffer; emits IllegalStateException when the buffer is full (overflow posture ERROR) - the false path is an error, never a silent drop.
Hot fan-out of published events, consumed by PipelineSubscriber.
